name: Hash Map-based Sparse Data Structure
aliases: Rendering Data Structure (Implicit Surface Cell Hash Map)
definition: A data structure using a hash map to efficiently access a compact cell list of particles sorted by a self-similar ordering (Morton code), designed for adaptive SPH on GPUs and CPUs.
summary: A hash map-based sparse data structure that maps spatial particle positions to memory locations using Morton codes to reduce SPH neighbor search complexity and support adaptive resolutions.
